Our client Convenience Marketing Solutions Pty Ltd trading as Shikha Transport has been at the forefront of Western Australia’s heavy transport sector — has a story of growth, innovation and an unwavering commitment to clients’ success. The  vision is to be the most trusted and efficient bulk-haulage partner for the resources and agricultural sectors in WA, delivering every load safely, on time, and with the utmost professionalism. 

Shikha Transport operates a modern fleet including quad and super-quad trailer combinations to optimise payload and reduce vehicle movements. The services cover large-scale movement of iron ore, nickel, grain, sand and other essential raw materials, shuttle runs from mine sites to processing plants and ports, and timely agricultural haulage during peak harvest seasons. We provide integrated, end-to-end logistics solutions tailored to mining, construction and farming clients.

Shikha Transport is seeking full-time Truck Drivers experienced in heavy/bulk haulage to join its Maddington operations. These roles are vital to safely and efficiently moving high-volume bulk and palletised freight across WA, supporting production schedules, port transfers and construction/agricultural supply chains.

Essential requirements
-	AQF Certificate II or III in Driving Operations, or equivalent heavy vehicle qualification.
-	Minimum one year full-time experience in bulk haulage, multi-combination or heavy vehicle operations.
-	Valid MC (Multi Combination) driver licence (or applicable heavy vehicle licence for combination vehicles) with a clean driving history.
-	Demonstrated ability to safely operate quad / super-quad trailers and manage high-payload loads.
-	Familiarity with GPS, electronic logbook systems and modern fleet telematics.
-	Willingness to work flexible hours, including shift work, nights and occasional regional travel.

Key responsibilities are set out below: 

-	Safely operate heavy vehicles including quad and super-quad trailer combinations for bulk and palletised freight.
-	Perform shuttle runs, port transfers, site deliveries and bulk haulage for mining, agricultural and construction customers.
-	Load and unload cargo using appropriate equipment; secure loads in accordance with load-restraint requirements.
-	Conduct accurate pre-trip and post-trip inspections and complete vehicle defect reporting.
-	Maintain required driving and shift records (work diaries / electronic logbooks), fuel and mileage records.
-	Adhere to fatigue management rules, heavy vehicle regulations and Chain of Responsibility obligations.
-	Communicate proactively with dispatch and site personnel regarding ETAs, delays and site requirements.
-	Report vehicle faults and coordinate routine maintenance; assist with minor on-road repairs where safe and appropriate.
-	Uphold high standards of customer service and professional conduct at client sites.
-	Comply with site specific induction, safety and environmental protocols (PPE, permit to work, site inductions). 

Applications for this opportunity should be forwarded by email to: recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au 

Please note only short-listed candidates will be contacted and your application will be treated as strictly confidential.

Job Title:	Tree Worker
Salary range;	$79,500 - $82,000

About the Role
On behalf of our client - a trusted tree care specialist known for precise pruning, safe removals, and expert vegetation management - we are seeking a skilled Tree Worker. You will join a team dedicated to maintaining healthy, safe urban landscapes, working across residential and commercial sites. This role offers variety, from detailed tree assessments to high level climbing and line clearance.

Key Responsibilities & Duties
• Tree Health & Risk Assessment: Examine individual trees to evaluate structural condition, disease, and potential hazards from falling limbs or whole-tree failure; determine appropriate treatment or removal plans.
• Species Selection & Site Planning: Advise on optimal species selection for new plantings, considering local soil conditions, growth patterns, and long-term site management objectives.
• Advanced Climbing & Access: Safely ascend trees using ropes, harnesses, and elevated work platforms (EWPs) to access high limbs and branches for pruning or removal.
• Pruning & Maintenance: Maintain tree and shrub health by pruning limbs and shaping canopies with chainsaws and handsaws to promote strong structure and aesthetic form.
• Hazardous Tree Removal: Remove dead, decaying, or structurally unsound trees, including precision felling and stump grinding to restore site safety.
• Utility Line Clearance: Clear vegetation from overhead electricity and telecommunications lines to prevent outages and fire risks, adhering to strict safety clearances.

Requirements
• Minimum 2 years’ experience as a Tree Worker or Arborist.
• Valid climbing and EWP certifications.
• Competency with chainsaws, handsaws, and stump grinding equipment.
• Knowledge of tree biology, risk assessment, and utility vegetation management.
• Strong safety focus and physical fitness.
• Current driver’s license.

How to Apply
Submit your resume and cover letter via the application portal. We are acting on behalf of our client and will manage all shortlisting.

Please note: All applications are confidential. We are acting as the exclusive recruitment agent for this role, and our client’s identity will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates.

Kogan People Solutions is recruiting for a business specialising in the supply and installation of high-end stone products, including marble, porcelain, and other premium materials. The company provides expert fabrication and installation services, blending craftsmanship with the timeless design of products such as benchtops, stairs, and other elegant interiors for residential and commercial clients.

With a strong focus on quality, detail, and aesthetic excellence, they are currently seeking an experienced and qualified Stonemason to join the team. They are seeking a highly motivated individual who can demonstrate the care and attention to detail that this role requires. The role is full-time and ongoing.

Location – work is based in Eastern Creek NSW, with occasional on-site work.

Salary – negotiable in the range of $80k to $85k plus superannuation per annum.

About the role:

This role is based in a busy factory environment and will involve all aspects of factory work required to complete the job and prepare the goods for installation.

Responsibilities of the job include:

•	Expert cutting, shaping, finishing, polishing and handling natural or engineered stone such as marble, porcelain, granite, quartz and other materials.

•	Utilising a range of equipment and machinery to create stone interiors such as benchtops, stairs, splashbacks, sinks and other products.

•	Study and interpret plans, drawings, and specifications to determine materials required, measurements, and appropriate stonemasonry procedures.

•	Reading and interpreting technical drawings and specifications to ensure precise execution of stone products.

•	Mixing required glue and other adhesives to bond stone surfaces securely and ensure proper assembly during fabrication.

•	Operate hand and power tools in a safe and efficient manner, in compliance with company procedures and WHS regulations such as wearing personal protective equipment (PPE), handling materials properly and other safe work procedures.

•	Maintain cleanliness and order in the work area and assist in site clean-up upon project completion.

To be successfully considered, you:

•	Possess relevant trade Certificate III plus 2 years working experience  or Cert IV, ideally in the field of Stonemasonry (or a closely related building trade) or agreed substitute.

•	Have a minimum of 1 or more years working experience in the field, preferably within a factory setting.

•	Have competence and experience in handling masonry tools and materials.

•	Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to work from technical drawings.

•	Excellent communication skills to communicate effectively.

•	Possess White Card or willing to obtain before starting work.

•	Excellent team skills, patience, and empathy.

•	Have physical strength and stamina to work with and handle heavy materials.

•	Are prompt and reliable, with excellent time management skills.

•	Are eager to secure a full-time salaried position (so this role is not suitable for sub-contractors)

You must have unrestricted full time Australian working rights to be considered.

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV. 

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.
